D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Mark Takano leads by 25.8 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 65,853 votes; a one point swing is about 1,277 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +17.8 and D +33.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$233K cash against $3K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
